_comment: LexRAG RAG Evaluation Dataset — Template. Add your own question/answer pairs before running evaluation.

_schema.question: Natural language research question
_schema.document_id: UUID of the document containing the answer (null if cross-document)
_schema.expected_citation_ids: List of citation IDs that MUST appear in a correct answer
_schema.ground_truth_answer: Gold-standard answer text for faithfulness evaluation
